prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-04-02, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-04-02):
| Return 3m            | -6.6% |
| Return 1m            | -1.1% |
| Return 1w            | +1.6% |
| Range position (63d) | 31% |
| 21d realized vol     | 28% |
| Last close           | 165.81 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has weaker momentum over 3 months (-6.6%) and only a modest 1-week gain (+1.6%), suggesting no clear uptrend. With a mid-range positioning (31% in 63 days) and moderate realized volatility (21d vol ~28%), the risk-reward for a 20-day horizon is balanced rather than compelling. Given the lack of a strong catalyst or clear trend, a HOLD is prudent.

DECISION: HOLD
